activity.role: Poet publishing The Waste Land in The Criterion
activity.notes: 1922 denotes the first publication of The Waste Land in a British literary journal; it does not represent the duration of Eliot's writing career. The United Kingdom is the literary publication setting, not an assertion of Eliot's nationality in 1922.

sources.title: The British Library — T S Eliot's The Waste Land
sources.citation_text: The British Library documents Eliot's first publication of The Waste Land in The Criterion in October 1922, followed by The Dial in November and separate book editions.
